notes.title: ZLAN Tournament Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/ebc4863fabccb6f73c90bd858d6842dbd21151ee.gif

Hey everyone!

We've got a few fixes and balance tweaks going live today alongside some special content to celebrate the massive ZLAN tournament taking place this weekend. 

Patch notes below!


NEW:: Added new content for the upcoming Z LAN tournament. Sign in May 11-12 to permanently unlock the Z LAN disc, tag, and emblems!
TWEAKED:: Added a tiny bit of time to everyone's lobs except Kahuna's and Gator's.
TWEAKED:: Made Kahuna's lob slightly more effective.
TWEAKED:: Adjusted Kahuna's slide so he can early out a bit quicker.
TWEAKED:: Increased Kahuna's acceleration slightly so he can get to his top run speed faster.
TWEAKED:: Slowed Gator's lob so he is no longer the 3rd best lobber which was disproportionately strong given his other talents.
TWEAKED:: Decreased Gator's recovery time slightly. It is still the fastest but more in line with the other characters.
TWEAKED:: Adjusted Haruka's slide so she can early out a bit quicker.
FIXED:: Catching the disc while getting up from a slide no longer gives you additional time to throw with perfect timing.
FIXED:: Haruka's fireball taunt now works correctly in-game.

notes.title: Patch 1.21 Hotfix
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/9533be4059947f86c66624e0517d7ad4fd4a3957.gif

Hey all,

We've just launched a quick patch to fix some issues discovered in the last major update:


 TWEAKED: Lowered the volume of the wall impact sound on Penthouse.
 FIXED: Servers no longer crash when a player quits during an instant replay. This resolves issues that could cause players to receive a loss after a match ends even if they just won.
 FIXED: Points on the scoreboard once again display correctly but are capped at 200. This cap will be raised in a future patch.
 FIXED: Added a speculative fix for issues observed on high refresh-rate monitors.
 FIXED: Throw indicator once again displays when playing matches online.


Sincerely, 
Jim Jam

notes.title: Penthouse Update Goes Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/494282217f4d01bafebe8cd88820b48248ea3908.gif
Greetings all!

It has been far too long since our last update but we have just launched the new map alongside a bunch of new content!  Once the patch is live across all platforms, we will begin Season 2 and activate the playlist for the new mode: Disc Dodger!  

Please see below for patch notes:


NEW: Added a tiled arena -- The Penthouse.

NEW: Added a game mode -- Disc Dodger (more info on this to follow!)

NEW: 156 NEW content items:


   13 discs
   36 skins
   15 taunts
   18 victory poses
   18 emblems
   56 tags


NEW: Match settings can now be customized in private, LAN, and splitscreen matches.

NEW: Added Cinematic Instant Replays for epic rallies.

NEW: Added Player Highlight Vignette following Instant Replays.

NEW: Server region and instance ID can now be viewed on the in-game scoreboard menu.

TWEAKED: Normalized throw timing between forehand and backhand animations.

TWEAKED: Added 100ms across the board to all super throw timers.

TWEAKED: Slightly decreased Gator's slide recovery.

TWEAKED: Slight increase to Kahuna's blue throw.

TWEAKED: Increase Kahuna curve width.

TWEAKED: Gave Kahuna's slide a bit more distance.

TWEAKED: Quick curves are now capped as to how wide they can go.

TWEAKED: Throw timer now continues to tick down after the disc is caught while sliding. Getting up from a slide and throwing with perfect timing will still result in throwing the disc with a blue trail.

TWEAKED: Deflecting a disc at the net with a fully charged shield now performs a stuff block instead of charging a super throw.

FIXED: The indicator at a player's feet will no longer erroneously display purple even though the disc is thrown with a blue trail.

FIXED: Player names are now displayed correctly on all viewports while playing splitscreen.

FIXED: Adjust Lannie's animations that were keeping her in her throw stance for too long.

FIXED: Updated Haruka cloth simulation to address interpenetration issues.

FIXED: Reporting an opponent using a secondary controller no longer causes loss of player control after the menu closes.

notes.title: Patch 1.10 Tomorrow: Introducing Tickets!
notes.notes:
Although we underestimated the time it would take to get this update through QA, patch 1.10 will finally be released tomorrow afternoon. This update includes cross-play between platforms but it also includes another highly requested item: no more duplicates in the Prize Machine!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/f91c054478891c5ed2bd9e1b5750c501e0ff606f.png

Instead of duplicates, players will now receive Tickets. The rarer the capsule, the more you will receive. Once you have accumulated enough Tickets, items can be purchased directly from the Customization menu rather than having to wait for them to pop out of the Prize Machine. This way you're always making progress when visiting the Prize Machine and you'll also be able to save up to get that specific item you've been waiting for!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/71b2b1d368f4bea6d006b8628f950bc2ca3fcd41.png

Here are the full patch notes:

 NEW: Disc Jam now supports cross-play!

 Get matched with players on other platforms by toggling the option in the matchmaking settings popup.
 Leaderboards now list all players but can be filtered by platform.


 NEW: Introducing tickets! Instead of salvaging duplicates from the Prize Machine, players will now receive tickets. These tickets can then be redeemed inside the Customize menu to unlock a specific piece of content directly.

 NEW: Players can now be reported from the in-game scoreboard.

 Reports can be submitted for players who are griefing, harassing other players, or who have inappropriate names.


 FIX: Taskbar once again flashes when a match is found.

 FIX: Fixed the timer displayed for remote party members while matchmaking.

 FIX: Fixed up our Beam integration now that Beam has been rebranded as Mixer.

 FIX: Fixed a bug where opening the in-game menu with the scoreboard open could cause the menu to lose focus when the scoreboard button is released.

notes.title: Patch 1.08: Stats and Rankings!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/0ca07d86b7b71e827701d5cc434d594f664bb9ef.png

We're still working hard on your most requested features and content.  In the meantime, we've just added a first pass of stats and leaderboards!  We've also made some small fixes/tweaks.  See the patch notes below!


NEW: Added stat tracking! Press the STATS button on the main menu to display your lifetime statistics. Highlight any stat to to see where you rank globally and among your friends. Compare your stats against another player by selecting them from within the leaderboards. We're tracking a TON of stuff under the hood now so expect more to come!
NEW: Added skill ratings and skill-based matchmaking! Play 10 provisional matches to receive an estimated skill rating. This rating is used to rank you globally and among your friends as well as to find you matches that better match your skill level.
NEW: Added some requested flags.
NEW: Lobs are now punished by poor timing.  Mistimed lobs will take longer to land and are more susceptible to perfect/supers.
TWEAKED: Reduced volume of air horn sound.
TWEAKED: Updated footstep SFX attenuation.
TWEAKED: Fixed up some of the player emblems. 
TWEAKED: Adjusted scale of the patterns on Haruka's skins.
TWEAKED: Slightly reduced Makenna's speed and acceleration.
TWEAKED: Increased Haruka's slide speed/length.
TWEAKED: Increased Haruka's perfect throw speed and juiced throw speed.
FIXED: Face buttons on the controller no longer trigger repeat button presses in the UI when held down.
FIXED: Cleaned up some artifacts in Haruka's animations.

notes.title: Custom Lobby Revamp in the latest Beta Patch!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/b548ce7e9329fb473491163f238b706f4055e4d4.png

Hey everyone! Been a while since our last patch but that's because we were adding one of our most frequently requested features: our overhaul of the private match lobby!  We've also been preparing for a very exciting announcement later in the week so stay tuned for that... In the meantime, fire up the new patch and let us know your thoughts!


NEW: Added completely revamped Private Match lobby. This allows players to change their roles/teams in the lobby before the match starts. Up to 3 players can now spectate private matches.
NEW: Added new Super Throw, "The Spiral". As its name suggests, this throw hurtles toward the end zone while making a circular motion.
NEW: Added flags for Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Romania, and Poland.
IMPROVED: First polish pass on Makenna's model, more to follow.
TWEAKED: Normalized everyone's lob to behave more like Gator's middle ground lob
FIX: Fix for rare networking crash bug.
FIX: Fix for a rare crash when respawning.
FIX: Fixed an issue where Steam would appear to fully utilize an entire CPU core during a match.
FIX: Fix for matchmaking popup staying on screen when spamming the button through the matchmaking flow.
FIX: Movement assist should no longer snap directions instantaneously after a deflection.

notes.title: Some Big Changes and Improvements!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/b323ec1a3027efc0b39743f332a50df220c77be2.png

Hey everyone!

Pretty exciting build update this week with some significant changes to the charge and deflection mechanics.  This is a more experimental build than usual so we hope you'll reserve judgement until you've had some time to digest these changes and, as always, give us your feedback on our discord or subreddit!  

Patch Notes:

NEW: We now support a wider (no pun intended) range of aspect ratios! Both 4:3 and 21:9 are supported! (EXPERIMENTAL)
NEW: Added in-game matchmaking region selection. We try to default to a reasonable region, but make sure to select the region nearest you when searching for games!
NEW: Added maximum ping filter when matchmaking. Selecting lower values should mean better connections, but may also result in longer matchmaking times!
NEW: In the Options menu, streamers can now select a delay for the chat bot. This is useful in preventing the bot from spoiling the outcome of matches.
NEW: Partially charged supers now grant the player extra time for a perfect throw.
IMPROVED: The charge meter material has been changed to clamp instead of blend between throw speed colors (pink/blue/white).
IMPROVED: If a host leaves a match mid-game, you will not matchmake back into them for a short while.

notes.title: Big Gameplay Update! Patch Notes - 12/15/16
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/cd6327668dbf5257a0ba1cf460345b76e6a3867a.png

Chat with us on Reddit and Discord
First off, we want to announce our reddit page has been updated and will be our primary forum going forward.  We also have a Discord server for players to find matches, discuss new mechanics, and give feedback.

Now, onto the good stuff!

Patch Notes

 NEW: Overhauled the deflection mechanic.

 Hold A to charge shield which now slows you down over time.
 A fully charged shield guarantees a super.
 The supers have all been buffed to compensate for the increased difficulty in execution.

 NEW: Overhauled the lob mechanic.

 Lobs no longer contribute to the perfect/juice system and in fact will break your perfect streak if deployed.
 Aiming lobs is no longer restricted by horizontal damping.  You should be able to place the lob anywhere on the court from any position.
 Timing does not affect the success of the lob throw.  You will throw the same lob if you hold it and run for a bit.
 Visuals and physics completely reworked.  The shot flies up high quickly then floats downward with very little forward movement.
 This fixes issues catching lobs from very far in front of the landing point.

 NEW: Perfect timing on supers results in a SUPER RETURN which fires back a super based on whatever throw button was pressed
 NEW: Quick chat has been added on the D-Pad for easy mid-game communication.  There are 4 categories (Cheers, Jeers, Bold, Cold) with 4 phrases in each.  Taunt has been moved to RB as a result.
 NEW: Added audio and visual cue for wall skips so it is much easier read when one is incoming
 NEW: Added 10 new player emblems
 NEW: Disc hologram is now a generic locator disc shape
 NEW: Laser pylons now blast the disc on all winning points (previously only blasted on goals)
 FIXED: Point starts correctly at (5) and aces are now worth double points (10)
 FIXED: Deflections no longer bring you forward and are directed primarily for setting up the new charge/super mechanic.  There is no longer an offensive advantage to quick tapping the shield
 FIXED: Corrected material slots on the discs which was causing overly bright materials on Future disc (hopefully addresses the 'wobble' issue that was brought up)
 FIXED: Quit buttons re-added for PC only (were removed for PS4)
 FIXED: Spamming purchase button with insufficient funds no longer triggers audio nightmare
 FIXED: Hid tutorial button from party clients
 FIXED: Chat box scrolling no longer trims off the bottom line of long posts
 FIXED: Rapid wall bounce issue on Pythagoras has been fixed
 FIXED: Can no longer be scored on while charging a super from the edge of the end zone
 FIXED: Removed "Rematch" option from spectators in post game screen
 FIXED: Game camera now properly tracks the ragdolls during post-point fanfare 
 TWEAKED: Punched up Makenna's "Loser" pose and Stanton's "Yay" pose

notes.title: Online Test 3 Schedule & Patch Notes - March 18th & 19th
notes.notes:
Schedule
Friday March 18th & Saturday March 19th
3pm to 9pm EST (New York)
12pm to 6pm PST (California)
16:00 to 22:00 BRST (São Paulo)
19:00 to 1:00 GMT (London)
20:00 to 2:00 CET (Paris)
22:00 to 4:00 MSK (Moscow) 

Patch Notes
We're very excited to share the BIG changes that went into this build!  Our top feature request on our roadmap was adding our next character so we're happy to announce that Makenna has joined the fun!  Small but speedy, Makenna covers a lot of ground and can be a crippling defensive player.  Another massive change is the addition of SKILL CURVES!  You can now use the left stick during windup to add spin to your throw.  Check out our blog post for more details and see below for the full list of added features:


     NEW: Added Makenna to the roster
     NEW: SKILL CURVES added!  New throw mechanic for adding spin to the disc during windup
     NEW: Disc physics overhauled to enable disc skipping and spin-based ricochet
     NEW: Added end game screen with rematch flow to get players back in game faster
     NEW: 32-bit Windows is now supported
     IMPROVED: All new full body throw animations
     IMPROVED: Throw curvature is now indicated by tilt angle
     IMPROVED: Full UI reskin
     FIXED: Lobby countdown not resetting 
     TWEAKED: Power throws are now harder to track and should be more effective
     TWEAKED: RT/LT curve throws updated to be "quick curves" with faster release time than all other throws


Want to watch and live chat with us?
We will be discussing our changes live on our twitch channel from 2pm to 4pm PST

What do I do next?
In the meantime, make sure you've redeemed your Steam key and downloaded the game client. If you haven't yet received your key and you're unable to get one from discjamgame.com, please check out this post.

How do I play?
Check out our 'How To Jam' page for a description of the rules, the controls, and some tips on how to jam like a pro. Once you're playing, you can also press Start or ESC to open the in-game menu and get a refresher.

Can I use a controller?
Yes! In fact, we recommend using a Microsoft Xbox 360 or Microsoft Xbox One controller for the best experience. If you don't have one, no worries, you can still play using a traditional keyboard.

Can my friends play?
Of course! If your friends want to play and they haven't signed up yet, send them over to discjamgame.com. They'll receive a Steam key as soon as they sign up and verify their email address.

Can I stream this or post videos?
Definitely! Everyone is encouraged to stream the game and upload footage wherever they wish. We're excited to share the game with the world, build a community, and get everyone involved in helping us make Disc Jam the best game it can be.
